summary: One party’s leader introduces the replacement text with the other party’s leader standing beside him.
realLife: Mansfield stood beside Dirksen when Dirksen offered their negotiated substitute on May 26.
gates: A negotiated substitute is ready for introduction.
inGame: floor-debate identifies the bill and speakers. needs: a substitute text with named negotiators and an offering member.

turns.what: One negotiator offers the substitute and the other explains a reservation on the floor.
turns.pulledBy: Their agreement leaves a section open to later amendment.
turns.writesBack: The record carries both the offer and the reservation.

turns.what: The partners wait for the clerk's corrected copy before offering the substitute.
turns.pulledBy: The copy at the desk differs from their agreed text.
turns.writesBack: The corrected version is the one entered on the floor.
